resolution.note: renderAdvisorTrial prints per-unit table and thin-win flag (N option, default 5); node --test test/outcome passes

title: Show per-unit results and flag wins carried by few units
body:
Source: t-tpkc9xz trial (radar 2), .krn/runs/research/rss-trials/f-g-h-radar.md
Outcome: The A/B/C report in src/outcome/advisor-trial.ts prints a per-unit table and flags any arm win carried by fewer than N units (N=5 default).
Proof: node --test test/outcome with a 4-unit fixture asserting the thin-win flag is printed.
